# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.x | Yes |

## Reporting A Vulnerability

Please do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.

Report vulnerabilities privately by emailing [open-source@otgh.cloud](mailto:open-source@otgh.cloud) with:

- Affected version(s)
- Clear reproduction steps
- Expected impact
- Any proof-of-concept material

We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 business days and provide status updates as triage progresses.
